Technologically, all Qijing models will feature the Huawei Qiankun suite, including Qiankun Intelligent Driving, Harmony Cockpit, Qiankun Vehicle Control, Qiankun In-Vehicle Optics, and Qiankun Vehicle Cloud. KTransformers, jointly open-sourced by Converge Technology and Tsinghua University, has become the recommended inference engine for major models like Qwen, Kimi, and Zhipu AI on their launch days. Its engineering practices and compatibility have been adopted by multiple all-in-one product lines, making it a widely reused collaborative underlying framework by developers, manufacturers, and the open-source community.

Technically and ecologically recognized, KTransformers was successfully selected for SOSP 2025, known as the "Oscar of computer systems." It is a high-performance heterogeneous inference framework focused on efficiently utilizing diverse computing resources such as GPUs, CPUs, and memory, enabling large models to run efficiently on lower computing power and more flexible hardware architectures. Its paper, "KTransformers: Unleashing the Full Potential of CPU/GPU Hybrid Inference for MoE Models," was accepted by SOSP 2025, a top conference that has witnessed the debut of numerous milestone technologies like virtualization and distributed file systems over the decades, marking global top-tier recognition of KTransformers' technical strength.

Su práctica de ingeniería y compatibilidad han sido adoptadas por varias líneas de productos integrados, convirtiéndose en un marco subyacente colaborativo ampliamente reutilizado por desarrolladores, fabricantes y la comunidad de código abierto. Reconocimiento dual en tecnología y ecosistema: seleccionado con éxito en SOSP 2025, el "Óscar de los sistemas informáticos". KTransformers es un marco de inferencia heterogéneo de alto rendimiento, centrado en el uso eficiente de las GPU subyacentes.

Gyges Labs recently completed its Pre-A+ funding round, with investments from Granite Asia and CanCan Capital. Following the international success of its jointly launched AI glasses, Halliday, the funding will primarily support the expansion of a more diverse range of "superhuman gear" (AI wearable products), with new products scheduled to debut starting in early 2026.

Unlike approaches that aim to replace humans with AI, Gyges Labs is an AI wearable technology company dedicated to "enabling everyone to become a superhuman." The company operates globally, with its headquarters in Singapore, software and AI teams based in Silicon Valley, and leverages China's supply chain advantages, featuring unique technologies such as advanced optics and active AI.

Just as Iron Man and Batman's gear empowers ordinary individuals, Gyges Labs believes that applying AI to wearable products, allowing humans to harness AI, makes people more irreplaceable than directly providing AI with physical capabilities.

Luo Tingxia, founding partner of CanCan Capital, stated: "As a next-generation investment firm focused on technology and consumer sectors, we are committed to discovering and supporting companies that define the future. Gyges Labs perfectly embodies this vision. While the smart glasses industry is still exploring forms, they have strategically positioned themselves at the forefront of the next human-computer interaction interface with their forward-looking insights into 'invisibility' and 'proactivity.' Their team demonstrates exceptional product definition capabilities and a pragmatic approach."

Convertir a las personas en superhumanos podría ser el enfoque correcto para el paradigma de interacción humano-máquina. excerpt_i18n.en:
On November 17th, AI+ consumer robotics company Ling Universe announced the completion of a 200 million yuan Pre-A series funding round, with investors including Didi Chuxing, Lakala, Shanghai International, Guotai Haitong, and GF Xinde. This follows a previous round last year backed by capital from 37 Interactive Entertainment, SenseTime, and Linear Capital.

Recently, at their office in Beijing's Wangjing area, we met with Ling Universe founder Gu Jiawei for an in-depth conversation. Gu's background includes roles as a Microsoft Research Asia researcher, "Baidu Young Leader," principal R&D architect at Baidu's Institute of Deep Learning, and MIT Technology Review's TR35 innovator. In 2016, he joined a listed A-share company as vice president and co-founded Wuling Technology, where he discussed his vision of "everything has spirit" in an interview with Leifeng. In 2023, Gu re-entered entrepreneurship by founding Ling Universe to continue his startup vision.

The new company, though small, is fully equipped. In a conference room under 100 square meters, a prominent cartoon at the entrance depicts a future where robots serve tea, act as nannies, and perform nearly all human-needed services. Gu stated this has been his goal since his first venture, but the timing was premature then. Now, with rapid advancements in large models, he believes the moment is right to pursue this vision.

Esta es otra ronda tras la inversión del año pasado de capitales como 37 Interactive Entertainment, SenseTime y Linear Capital. Hace poco, en nuestra oficina de Wangjing, Pekín, nos reunimos con el fundador de Ling Universe, Gu Jiawei, y mantuvimos una conversación en profundidad. Exinvestigador de Microsoft Research Asia, "Joven Genio de Baidu", arquitecto jefe de desarrollo del Instituto de Aprendizaje Profundo de Baidu e innovador tecnológico del MIT TR35, así es Gu Jiawei.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 雷峰网消息，11月18日，全球首款面向6-12岁儿童的AI外教一对一产品——“斑马口语”正式发布，其主打“超人类AI外教”，通过超人类的AI外教与孩子一对一全英授课，让每个孩子都能拥有一个专属的AI外教。 斑马口语的上线，标志着AI大模型从通用探索走到了垂直行业的真正落地，是教育行业首个真正产业化落地的AI Agent。 “超人类外教”诞生：AI外教能行吗？ 在儿童口语学习培养上，家长们普遍会遇到“真人外教不好找不好约、专业水平不稳定，孩子害怕开口”等难题。而斑马口语通过“超人类AI外教”，解决了这些难题。AI Agnet的优势不难理解：超强的记忆力，存储能力。能够记住孩子上课的每个瞬间，从每次开口的表现、知识积累，到独特的口头禅、兴趣爱好、性格特点等。斑马口语能实现“主导型AI外教”的突破，关键在于其选择在 “儿童一对一口语” 这个极其狭窄的场景里，做足了深度功夫。 这要求AI必须同时具备多重能力：第一，是“听得懂孩子”的语音识别能力，能辨析儿童不标准的口音、断续的语句和跳跃的思维；第二，是“教得好孩子”的教学逻辑，其背后是融合了二语习得理论、儿童认知心理学和海量教学案例的复杂算法；第三，是“哄得住孩子”的人格化交互能力，这意味着AI需要理解儿童的喜怒哀乐，并能用恰当的幽默、鼓励和共情来维持他们的学习兴趣。修佳明对此坦言：“通用大模型可以处理广泛的话题，但正是因为我们把边界收得足够窄，才能在这些垂直维度上做得足够深。斑马口语的本质，不是一个会说话的AI Agnet，而是一个被高度‘专业化’和‘人格化’了的教学专家。” 而对部分家长所担心的安全问题，斑马首席产品官修佳明表示，斑马对模型的训练有三个阶段，都针对进行了很严格的动作。在模型训练阶段，因为是自研大模型，斑马首先对训练数据进行了比较严格的清洗，用的都是适龄材料。在测试阶段，斑马也会有测试级验证的方式去确定这个模型的表
excerpt_i18n.en:
On November 18, Leiphone reported the launch of Zebra Spoken English, the world's first one-on-one AI tutor product for children aged 6–12. It features a "superhuman AI tutor" that provides personalized, full-English instruction, ensuring every child has a dedicated AI tutor. This release marks the transition of large AI models from general exploration to practical application in specific industries, representing the first truly industrialized AI Agent in education. 

The "superhuman tutor" addresses common challenges in children's oral English learning, such as difficulty finding and scheduling human tutors, inconsistent expertise, and children's reluctance to speak. AI Agents excel with superior memory and storage, recalling every moment of a child's lessons—from speaking performance and knowledge accumulation to unique habits, interests, and personality traits. Zebra Spoken English achieves this breakthrough by focusing intensely on the narrow scenario of one-on-one children's oral practice. This requires the AI to possess multiple capabilities: first, speech recognition that understands children, deciphering non-standard accents, fragmented sentences, and erratic thinking; second, teaching logic that effectively educates, supported by algorithms integrating second language acquisition theory, child cognitive psychology, and extensive teaching cases.
excerpt_i18n.es: Según Leifeng, el 18 de noviembre se lanzó oficialmente "Zebra Oral", el primer producto mundial de tutoría individual de IA para niños de 6 a 12 años. Destacado por su "tutor de IA sobrehumano", ofrece clases individuales totalmente en inglés, permitiendo que cada niño tenga un tutor de IA exclusivo. Su lanzamiento marca la transición de los modelos de IA de exploración general a aplicaciones específicas en sectores verticales, siendo el primer agente de IA verdaderamente industrializado en educación. Con el surgimiento del "tutor sobrehumano", surge la pregunta: ¿funcionará el tutor de IA? En el aprendizaje oral infantil, los padres suelen enfrentar dificultades para encontrar y reservar tutores humanos, junto con la inconsistencia en su nivel profesional.
